name: XLA_DIAG_LEDGERS
description: This table contains the information related to the ledgers used by the accounting program to create journal entries.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the application accounting definition.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Owner for the application accounting definition.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Internal context code that is associated to accounting method builder.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Associated accounting program request identifier.

columns.name: PRIMARY_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary ledger internal identifier.

columns.name: SLA_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Subledger accounting ledger internal identifier.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Abbreviated name associated with description language.

columns.name: NLS_DESC_LANGUAGE
columns.description: NLS description language code.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Entered currency for the subledger journal entry line.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Effective start date for accounting application definition.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Effective end date for accounting application definition.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
